candidates.name: OS Downloads API Technical specification
verified_facts: OS OpenData parts of the Downloads API do not require an API Key.
Premium data-package endpoints require an API Key or OAuth2 token.
semantic_limits: The documentation does not prove this support runtime can resolve api.os.uk DNS.

candidates.name: Automating OS OpenData downloads
verified_facts: The official OpenData example calls https://api.os.uk/downloads/v1/products without an API key.
The download flow consumes returned download.url values directly.
semantic_limits: Example workflow is a transport contract, not evidence of current TQ elevation bytes.

candidates.name: Download an OpenData product
verified_facts: TQ is an allowed area value.
format and area filters are supported.
redirect returns 307 when exactly one download matches.
semantic_limits: Endpoint contract is not proof of a successful request from the support runtime.
